**Summary:** Córdoba's tech scene is small but genuine. **SalmorejoTech** (annual May conference, VII edition May 8 2026, 400+ attendees, free, two tracks at UCO Rectorate) is the flagship — the best reason to time a tech visit. **GDG Córdoba** (108 members) runs meetups every 6–8 weeks at the UCO Aula de Software Libre. **Python Córdoba** is dormant but active in prior years. SISTEDES (national software engineering conference) visited Córdoba in Sept 2025 and rotates annually. The research is backed by 15 cited sources with a cover SVG.
